verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for an open-source commerce framework with a CLI and hosted cloud, so the axis applies, but no evidence item mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or a way to disable them. The data sovereignty, SOC2 and DPA listings cover a different privacy control, not a telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
